results.title: Zip US Announces Expansion of Banking Partnerships to Support Long-Term Growth
results.content: The expansion of Zip's bank partnership model through the addition of a nationally chartered partner further diversifies the Company's banking relationships, supports funding cost efficiencies and strengthens operational resilience, reflecting the significant scale Zip has achieved. "Through our partnership with Column, we're strengthening the foundations of the business to support our next phase of growth and continue expanding access to transparent and responsible credit for millions of Americans." [...] of legacy banks and middleware — creating a faster and more reliable banking platform. Beyond payments and accounts, Column enables national lending and credit products, powering API-based loan-origination partnerships and deploying its balance sheet to fund lenders through debt financing and loan purchases.

# Adobe & NVIDIA announce an expansion of their partnership

Matthew Allard ACSComments

2 min read

Share

 X
 Facebook
 LinkedIn
 Reddit
 Email

  NVIDIA 

Adobe and NVIDIA have announced an expansion of their partnership to optimize Adobe’s flagship tools, including Adobe Photoshop, Premiere, Substance 3D, Frame.io and Brand Concierge. This is being done to deliver faster AI-powered creation, production, and personalization to customers. [...] Adobe and NVIDIA announced a strategic partnership back in March. That collaboration included GPU acceleration for media ingestion and intelligence in Frame.io, as well as ongoing work around Adobe Substance 3D, Adobe Firefly Foundry and 3D digital twin workflows for enterprise customers. [...] Adobe is also using NVIDIA accelerated computing to speed cloud media processing and intelligent content discovery for Adobe Frame.io. The updated Frame.io pipeline uses NVIDIA video acceleration, including NVIDIA NVDEC for hardware-accelerated decoding and NVIDIA TensorRT with CUDA for content preprocessing and embedding generation.

results.title: United, Air Canada expand partnership, add 6 routes for 2027 - The Points Guy
results.content:
United Airlines and Air Canada have agreed to expand their partnership on routes between the U.S. and Canada.

And the two carriers are planning to launch a half-dozen new routes between the two countries for next summer.

As part of the cross-border expansion, United on Friday announced it would return to St. John's in Canada's easternmost province of Newfoundland and Labrador for the first time in more than a decade. [...] In a statement to TPG, the carrier cited "commercial reasons," saying it "regularly reviews its schedule to ensure capacity is aligned with customer demand and travel patterns."

Air Canada plane on the tarmac

Air Canada Boeing 737 MAX 8. SEAN CUDAHY/THE POINTS GUY

## Joint venture expansion planned

Friday's route announcement between Air Canada and United came as the carriers announced an agreement to expand their cooperation on service between the U.S. and Canada. [...] Join over 700,000 readers for breaking news, in-depth guides and exclusive deals from TPG’s experts

This expansion will mark the first time United has offered service from Newark to St. John's since 2016.

The EWR-YYT route will give the airline a new easternmost destination in Canada.

Today, that label belongs to Halifax, which United already serves from three U.S. cities.

results.title: TransUnion Rises as Partnership Expansion and Reaffirmed Outlook Support Shares
results.content:
On October 14, TransUnion said it expanded its partnership with Bankrate to deliver more personalized credit offers to millions of consumers through its Credit Essentials platform and broader embedded channels.
   The company said the matching capability combines Bankrate’s lender marketplace with TransUnion’s credit data and Monevo offers technology, suggesting a larger consumer-engagement and monetization opportunity. [...] Analysis: The most plausible driver appears to be investor interest in TransUnion’s newly expanded partnership with Bankrate, which broadens distribution of personalized credit offers using the company’s credit data and offers technology. The move may also reflect a rebound after recent pressure, helped by management’s earlier reaffirmation of 2026 guidance and a still-upcoming earnings report later this month.
